title.narrative: Development and implementation of mechanisms of local self-government to improve the quality of life and economic development in rural settlements of three rural districts of the North Kazakhstan region

description.narrative: The action is aimed at strengthening local self-governance institutions and mechanisms to support economic development in Kyzylzhar, Aiyrtau and Mamlutka rural districts of the North Kazakhstan region with the overall objective to foster a functioning pluralistic, participatory and representative democracy in Kazakhstan.
